name: timeline
title: Timeline
description: Vertical timeline for order tracking, activity feeds, travel logs and release history, in the preview's solid accent colour. Items rise in, then the connector fills down to the current step: done dots draw their check as the line arrives, the current dot pulses, upcoming dots stay hollow on a dotted track, and failures draw a red cross. The scroll variant ties the fill to the scroll position, lighting each node as the line reaches it. Entries can carry photo galleries, tags and links.
